turns.utterance: Complete the initial coolant checks. First, check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. Then assess the coolant colour and odour for any signs of contamination. Finally, check the refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Initial checks complete. Coolant level is within marks, colour and odour appear normal, and I've taken the refractometer reading.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. 2. Assess coolant colour and odour for signs of contamination. 3. Check refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

turns.utterance: Severe contamination: tramp oil, biological growth or discolouration?

turns.utterance: No severe contamination detected. The coolant looks clean with no visible oil layer, biological growth, or significant discolouration.

turns.utterance: pH correction agent added according to the dosing table.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Read the inline flow meter display with the coolant pump running at normal operating speed. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare it against the minimum required flow rate for the machine specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Read the inline flow meter display with the coolant pump running at normal operating speed. Record the flow rate in litres per minute and compare against the minimum required flow rate for the machine specification. If no inline meter is fitted, use the timed bucket method at the main return line and calculate flow rate from volume and elapsed time.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow meter reading recorded. I've compared it against the specification.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Filter element replaced and strainer basket cleaned.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify flow rate after filter replacement.

turns.utterance: Flow rate is now back within specification after the filter replacement.

turns.utterance: The coolant return temperature is elevated above the operating range.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits, check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value, and verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits. 2. Check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value. 3. Verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Heat exchanger, pump pressure, and nozzle checks completed.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits. 2. Check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value. 3. Verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Clean or replace nozzles as needed.

ground_truth.node_text: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Blocked nozzles should be soaked in descaler for 10 minutes then cleared with a wire of the correct gauge. Replace nozzles where the orifice shows erosion or enlargement beyond the nominal drill size.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All nozzles removed and inspected. I've cleaned the blocked ones and replaced those with eroded orifices.

ground_truth.node_text: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Blocked nozzles should be soaked in descaler for 10 minutes then cleared with a wire of the correct gauge. Replace nozzles where the orifice shows erosion or enlargement beyond the nominal drill size.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

ground_truth.node_text: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

turns.utterance: Some nozzles are still blocked or misaligned after the initial inspection.

turns.utterance: Unblock or replace the blocked coolant nozzles.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Blocked nozzles have been unblocked and replaced as necessary.

ground_truth.node_text: Unblock or replace blocked coolant nozzles

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: With the coolant pump running, observe the chip conveyor return flow inlet at the sump end. Verify that coolant is flowing visibly back to the sump through the return channel.

ground_truth.node_text: With the coolant pump running, observe the chip conveyor return flow inlet at the sump end. Coolant should be flowing visibly back to the sump through the return channel. Absence of return flow indicates a blocked return strainer or a conveyor drive fault; check the return strainer basket and clear any accumulated chip material.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Observing the chip conveyor return flow now. I can see the coolant returning to the sump.

ground_truth.node_text: With the coolant pump running, observe the chip conveyor return flow inlet at the sump end. Coolant should be flowing visibly back to the sump through the return channel. Absence of return flow indicates a blocked return strainer or a conveyor drive fault; check the return strainer basket and clear any accumulated chip material.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, coolant is flowing back properly through the chip conveyor return channel.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

turns.utterance: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

turns.utterance: Sediment depth is below 20 millimetres at all measurement points.

ground_truth.node_text: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

turns.utterance: Perform a system function test. Run a machine cycle and verify coolant delivery.

ground_truth.node_text: System function test, run machine cycle, verify coolant delivery

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: System function test complete. Machine cycle ran successfully and coolant delivery is verified.

ground_truth.node_text: System function test, run machine cycle, verify coolant delivery

turns.utterance: Log the coolant data, refractometer reading, and update the service record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All coolant data logged and service record updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coolant data, refractometer reading and update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Return the machine to normal production operation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, returning machine to production.
